title: On Rhetoric: A Theory of Civic Discourse (Aristotle), translated by George A. Kennedy

verification.verification_notes: Translation, publisher, and ISBN confirmed via Oxford University Press catalogue and Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy's account of the Rhetoric. Book II treats pathos and Book III treats style and arrangement.

limitations: English translation of a Greek technical vocabulary; emotional-appeal terms do not map one-to-one onto modern 'tone'.
